A '''space station''' was located somewhere in the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]]. By [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], it had been abandoned. The space station briefly served as the refuge for the people of the moon [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]], who tried to escape from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Sulonese were soon evacuated to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sympathizer [[Morgan Katarn]].
